item.title: GlideMix 1.2.5
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.2.5

  • Edit like in Ableton: Z zooms to the selection, X goes back, ⌘E splits, ⌘L loops, R reverses, ⌘1–⌘4 set the grid (Ctrl on Windows).
  • Some keys moved: Split is now ⌘E (was ⌘I), Record is F9, Rename is ⌘R.
  • Tidier right-click menus, with Cut / Paste / Delete time and a Grid section.
  • Thin automation lines with the value beside each point (dB, %, BPM).
  • Toolbar: icons only, grouped by job; hover a button to see what it does.
  • ⌘A selects all songs in the library, or the whole timeline.
  • Fixed a crash when zoomed in very close.

item.title: GlideMix 1.2.4
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.2.4

  • Library preview fixes.

item.title: GlideMix 1.2.3
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.2.3: no more freezes, plus a few wishes

## Fixed

  • No more long freezes with a big library and many smart playlists. After a beat grid change (Alt+arrow keys or the Beatgrid editor), adding songs, or at start, GlideMix could stop responding for up to half a minute while it recounted every smart playlist, one full pass over the library each. It now reads the library once and does the counting in the background.
  • The Related tab's search box works. Type a title, artist, genre or `bpm:>125` and the related songs narrow down, with the same search rules as the music library.
  • Windows: Task Manager and the file properties show "GlideMix Beta v1.2.3", not "GlideMix 1.1 beta dev".

## New

  • Set the IN and OUT anchors from the keyboard. Select a song in the timeline, put the playhead where you want it and press Alt+I (IN) or Alt+O (OUT). Change the keys under Shortcuts if you like.
  • Rename a project from its … menu on the Home page (a saved project that isn't open).

item.title: GlideMix 1.2.2
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.2.2: your plug-ins play along

## Fixed

  • Tempo-synced plug-ins now follow the beat. Loopers, tape stops, beat gates, rumble generators and beat FX (TimeStop, Maddix Rumble, Serato Hex FX, Trance Gate and the like) loaded but did nothing: GlideMix never told them the tempo or where the song was. VST3 and Audio Unit plug-ins now get the tempo (tempo lane glides too), the beat and the bar, counted from your bar 1.
  • AIR plug-ins no longer crash GlideMix. AIR Compressor, AIR Enhancer and other plug-ins that carry their own copy of Qt (Serato Hex FX too) closed GlideMix a few seconds after they opened (Mac).
  • No crash when quitting with plug-ins like TimeStop or Hyperlift loaded.

item.title: GlideMix 1.2.1
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.2.1: your own toolbar

## New

  • Customize the toolbar, like Safari. Right-click an empty part of the toolbar (or click its gear) and drag buttons from the sheet into the toolbar, along it to move them, or out of it to take them off. Add a Space between groups, or a Flexible Space that pushes everything after it to the right. Show the buttons as icon and text, icon only or text only, with new GlideMix icons for SYNC, TEMPO, ENERGY, KEYLOCK, LINK, PERFORM, MIX NOW, ARM and RE-ENABLE. Drag the default set up (or click it) to put the toolbar back as it came. The toolbar changes as you go, and an emptied group leaves no gap.
  • Key column your way. Preferences > Music library > Key column: plain text, coloured text or coloured badges.

## Fixed

  • Tooltips showed an empty dark box. They show their text again.
  • Submenus (the track menu's Color, the effect picker's VST3 and AudioUnit lists, and every other one) opened only on a click. They open as you point at them again.
  • Transition dots: the dot at a clip's edge added a new dot every time you dragged it. It now moves the line's start or end, up and down, and stays on the edge.
  • Track headers sat a few pixels below their rows in the timeline. They line up again.
  • The library flashed to the top of the sidebar every second while songs were analysed. It stays where you scrolled.
  • Color > Intensity in the track header menu did nothing. It opens its slider now.
  • Buttons: OK, Cancel and the other text buttons in popups and dialogs are pills, like the rest of 1.2.

item.title: GlideMix 1.2.0
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.2.0: a new look

## New

  • A new, modern look. Rounded buttons, fields, lists and menus. Every panel is its own rounded card with a small gap around it. Buttons are pills: purple only when they are on, a thin outline when off.
  • A display at the top. The clock now sits in one display with the key, energy and place in the mix (song 2 of 4) of the song under the playhead, how much processor and disk GlideMix uses, and a light that is green while playing.
  • Toolbar in groups. Play controls, editing tools, SYNC/TEMPO/ENERGY/KEYLOCK, LINK/PERFORM and MIX NOW/ARM each sit in their own capsule.
  • New knobs and faders. Flat knobs with a thin arc in the channel's colour; hover or turn one to see its value. Slim faders with see-through glass caps, also on the track volume, the zoom sliders and the meter.
  • See-through menus. Menus and lists are slightly see-through, with what is behind them softly blurred (Mac; Windows 11 menus and lists). It costs nothing while you play: the system draws it.
  • Library toolbar on top. New, All, Select All, Analyze, Match and Related now sit in one row with the Key Wheel; the search is below them.
  • Light theme in GlideMix purple, instead of the pale lavender it had.
  • Smaller touches: rounded dialog buttons, ROOM/CUE as pills, the Workspace name above its picker, the LOW/MID/HIGH/COLOR buttons on each track as pills.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.33
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.1.33: Match, Related and Charcoal

## New

  • Match. A new button in the library toolbar. Turn it on and every list lights the Key cell green for songs that mix with the song under the playhead (and follows it as you play or move the playhead). In a transition, the song coming in counts.
  • Related. Opens a tab with the songs that go with the song under the playhead: the full song table, every column, sorting, drag and double-click as in the library. Same key first, then the closest BPM.
  • Match and Related settings (the gear next to Match), in the order DJs know: BPM ± % (half and double tempo too), Key (same key up to one step around), Energy, Year, Date Added, History (songs you played before and after it), same artist, genre, composer, remixer, label or colour, Rating (click the stars), Comment, any Tag column, same file format.
  • Charcoal theme. A darker look for the whole app. With Follow system theme on (the default), a dark Mac or PC now gets Charcoal. The previous dark theme is still there, now called Grey (Preferences > Appearance).
  • Sorting: click a column header a third time to go back to the list's own order (newest first in the library, a playlist's or folder's own order).
  • A new or opened project shows the Music library tab first, not the Project tab.

## Fixed

  • The pencil and plus icons in the Workspace menu were black on the dark menu.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.32
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.1.32: a faster library

## New

  • Your whole collection in the song list. GlideMix used to show 2000 songs at a time and load the next 2000 as you scrolled down, which made big collections stall more and more. Now the whole collection is in the list at once: scroll straight to the end, sort and search without waiting, even with 40,000 songs. The same for the lists of rekordbox XML, Lexicon, Engine DJ, Serato, Traktor, VirtualDJ and djay.
  • Select All means all. Select All, then Analyze (or any other action), reaches every song in the list, not only the first 2000.
  • Analyze: with many songs, the ones never analysed go first, and the Analyze count in the sidebar goes down as each one finishes.
  • Import from Rekordbox XML shows a small window while it reads the file, then how many songs it found and where they are.

## Fixed

  • Mac: quitting during the first moments after start, while GlideMix was still reading your other DJ apps, could crash it.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.31
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.1.31

## Fixed

  • Windows: freezes with network drives. If a mapped network drive was offline or not ready (its computer switched off, a share not available), GlideMix froze for up to 40 seconds, about every 40 seconds, even when you were not doing anything. GlideMix now looks for DJ libraries only on local drives (internal, USB, SD card) and does it in the background, so a slow drive can no longer hold up the window.
  • A DJ app library kept on a network share is still read: add its folder in Preferences > Library > Other DJ Apps.

Thanks to the tester who sent a very precise report.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.30
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.1.30

## Fixed

  • Mac: crash when hovering a track's volume fader. Moving the mouse over the volume fader in a track header could close GlideMix in 1.1.29. Fixed. The fader's value tip (like "0.0dB") shows again above the silver cap and follows it while you drag.
  • Pop-up tips whose control has just gone away (a track removed, a panel closed) are skipped instead of opened.
  • Crash reports now show where a crash really happened, so the next one is quicker to find and fix.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.29
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.1.29

## New

  • Waveforms like the Beatgrid editor. The timeline and the library now draw every song with the same colours and shape as the Beatgrid editor: pink and red kicks and bass, blue hi-hats, a bright core with the peaks around it. Each song's picture is redone once, in the background, the first time it is shown.
  • Your DJ apps on every drive. Engine DJ, Serato and VirtualDJ keep a library on each drive for the songs on it. GlideMix now reads them all, so a collection on an SD card or USB drive shows its full count, and a drive plugged in later shows up by itself.
  • Preferences > Library > Other DJ Apps:
  • Show or hide rekordbox XML, Engine DJ, Traktor, Serato DJ, VirtualDJ and djay (all shown after installing). A hidden app is not read at all.
  • Add a folder if one of your apps keeps its library somewhere else.
  • Stems share one transition. A song split into stems has one transition pill. Picking a transition, drawing a line or adding an effect reaches the song and all four stems, and one Undo takes it all back.
  • Low, Mid, High and Color lines from the track header glow in their colour, like the transition pill's lines.

## Small fixes

  • An empty library says how to add music, with an Add music folder button.
  • Picking a key on the key wheel no longer pushes the sidebar down.
  • Windows: stems always run on the processor; the GPU choice that could fail is gone.
  • About: the VST Compatible logo, Ableton Link in the credits, and the DJ apps GlideMix works with.
  • The library sidebar uses its own icon for other DJ apps.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.28
item.description:
# GlideMix v1.1.28

## New

  • Ableton Link. Turn on the LINK button in the toolbar and GlideMix shares your mix's tempo, beat and play/stop with other Link apps on your network: Resolume, TouchDesigner and other VJ software follow the mix, glides included. GlideMix leads; your mix keeps its own tempo.
  • Your other DJ apps, in GlideMix. Engine DJ, Traktor, Serato, VirtualDJ and djay appear in the library sidebar with their songs and playlists (read only). When GlideMix analyses a song one of them already knows, it takes that app's beat grid and key instead of working them out again. Traktor on Mac is read when you click it, so macOS only asks for your Documents folder if you use it.
  • Mixed In Key. The key and energy that Mixed In Key writes into the comment ("8A - Energy 7") are read on import, analysis and Import From File Tags. Song comments are now kept, and Edit Tags has Key, Energy and Rating.
  • Low, Mid, High and Color buttons in every track header: each shows that line over the whole song, so a quick bass cut anywhere in the track is one click away.
  • Library:
  • The song list no longer stops at 2,000: scroll on and the next songs load.
  • Song counts on smart playlists, Duplicates and Analyze in the sidebar.
  • ‹ Back after Show in Library takes you back to the list, search and song you came from.
  • Save a search as a smart playlist with the + beside the search box. The search syntax works as a smart playlist rule ("genre:house bpm:>125").
  • Columns for any tag in your files (Mood, Label, Remixer, MusicBrainz IDs…): right-click a column title > Add Tag Column.
  • Up, Down, Page Up/Down, Home and End move through the song list.
  • A preview volume slider.
  • Wider search box.
  • Playlists: right-click a playlist > Export as M3U8 Playlist, for other players and DJ apps.
  • Automation:
  • Right-click a point > Set value… to type an exact value: dB on the volume line, % on the others (100% is the normal level).
  • On the tempo line, Set tempo… takes a BPM.
  • Shift-click several points, then drag one: they all move together.

## Small fixes

  • The song's key shows in the clip header.
  • A library scan no longer makes GlideMix stall while it runs.
  • The + menu for closed tabs no longer overlaps the tabs.
  • The song count above the list is right for smart playlists, Duplicates and other apps' lists.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.27
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.27 (Mac and Windows)

Important fixes

  • Adding a song no longer resets your transitions. Before, adding a song at the end of a mix reset every transition to the default and could move songs. Now only the new song moves and gets a transition. Everything you shaped by hand stays.
  • No more sudden quits when the project can't be backed up. If GlideMix can't write its automatic backup (disk full, or the file is in use by a sync or antivirus tool), it now warns you instead of closing.

Volume and automation lines, reworked

  • Easier to grab: bigger points, the nearest one is picked, and points on the IN/OUT lines can be dragged.
  • Cleaner: no more clusters of dots. Each fade shows only its corners.
  • Press and drag on a line adds a point and moves it in one go.
  • All lines work like the volume line: 100% sits at about three-quarters height, and above it boosts.
  • Transition lines get dots in their own colour.
  • The vertical ruler now shows the volume scale in dB, lined up with the volume line.

Library

  • Click a song's waveform to preview it from that spot. While your mix plays, it starts on the same beat of the bar, at the mix's tempo.
  • Analysis continues by itself after GlideMix is closed or stops unexpectedly. A file that stops it twice is skipped.
  • Songs added during analysis are now analysed in the same run.

From our users' requests

  • Mouse wheel zooms the timeline: an option in Preferences > Waveforms. Hold Cmd or Ctrl to scroll the tracks.
  • Phrase ribbon on or off: a new switch in Preferences > Waveforms.
  • Space plays the song in the Beat grid editor while you work in it.
  • Your own transitions come first in the menus. "Show in menus" hides the ones you don't use.
  • Quick Links: every folder can be removed. + adds it back.
  • A + beside the Music library and Project tabs opens a closed tab again.

Small fixes

  • A point near the end of a song now opens its own menu, not the track menu.
  • A line that is flat to the end of a song stays flat when you move the point before it.
  • Volume points sit above the phrase ribbon, where they can be clicked.
  • The effects panel no longer shows a "Watch video" link.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.26
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.26 (Mac and Windows)

Faster and more reliable

  • Export is much faster. A 16-minute mix now takes under 30 seconds on our Mac.
  • Plug-ins: fixed a bug that could slow the app down or stop it working.
  • Stems: fixed an install failure on some Macs.
  • MP3 exports no longer clip at normal bitrates.
  • Starts cleaner: you get to your music with fewer questions. The plug-in check waits for your first Add effect, and the licence window for your first export.

New in the library, from our users' requests

  • A dot marks songs already in your project.
  • The list shows its song count and total length, for searches and playlists too.
  • Hover the search box to see its filters, like genre:house bpm:>125.
  • Right-click a song on the timeline for Show in Library.
  • The library now keeps its last four backups.

Small fixes

  • Home shows how many songs each project holds.
  • The File menu says Save project and Save project as.
  • The transition pill shows the transition's name.
  • One Undo fully reverses Mix Now, including the OUT marker and the transition's name.
  • Closing the window on a Mac now really quits GlideMix.
  • The demo's export is now a proper 44.1 kHz MP3.
  • A plug-in that crashes during its check no longer brings up a crash message.
  • Cleaner wording on the first-run screens and in messages ("1 file", not "1 file(s)").

On a Mac: macOS may ask for permission one last time after this update. After that it should remember your answer.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.25
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.25 (Mac and Windows)

Fixes and requests from our users:

  • Tempo line: BPM markers at every transition, so you can see the tempo without scrolling back. Points and markers follow your theme color.
  • Reset on the tempo line now returns every track to its real BPM, and the Project tab shows the tempo each song really plays at.
  • Import From File Tags works: right-click songs > Metadata. Changed a tag in another app? Pull it into your library.
  • ReplayGain: tags are read when songs are added, and Import From File Tags fills in songs already in your library.
  • Show in Library: right-click a Project tab song to find the track, its album or its artist. Playlist songs get Show in Library too.
  • Search related Tracks: no more stuck filters. The search shows on the key wheel or in the search box, and one click clears it.
  • Drag preview: dragging a song onto the timeline now shows artist and title.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.24
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.24 (Mac and Windows)

We’ve polished the canvas and vaporized the bugs, making your GlideMix exports and artworks smoother than ever. Those glitches thought they were art, but we treated them like a bad sketch. Canvas cleared, bugs deleted. 🎨💥

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.23
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.23 (Mac and Windows)

A small update after v1.1.22 ✨

  • Help > What's new in 1.1.23 opens the What's new window whenever you want to read it again.
  • Cancel stops the whole range: pressing Cancel while a range of songs loads from the library now stops the load and keeps the songs already in the mix. Before, it only skipped the current song.

Also new since v1.1.21, from v1.1.22 🎚️

Big mixes stay usable 🎚️

  • With 30 songs or more, lanes, track headers and sliders no longer drift apart when you change the track view, zoom or scroll. No more restarting to fix the view.
  • You keep your place: the same song stays at the top while lanes change height or you switch track view.
  • New Reset view button in front of the zoom sliders: lanes back at their default height and the first songs of the mix readable.

Load a whole range from the library 📚

  • Click a song, Shift-click another, right-click and choose Load to > Project. They join the end of the mix in the same order, each one blended into the next, and the view shows the first of them.

The Project tab looks like the library 🖼️

  • Cover art, waveform, artist, year, key, genre, energy, duration, rating, comment and date added for every song in your mix.
  • Scroll sideways for more columns. The transition stays pinned on the right.

Also new ✨

  • GlideMix now tells you what changed the first time it starts after an update.
  • Single wave is the default track view on a fresh install.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.22
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.22 (Mac and Windows)

Big mixes stay usable 🎚️

  • With 30 songs or more, lanes, track headers and sliders no longer drift apart when you change the track view, zoom or scroll. No more restarting to fix the view.
  • You keep your place: the same song stays at the top while lanes change height or you switch track view.
  • New Reset view button in front of the zoom sliders: lanes back at their default height and the first songs of the mix readable.

Load a whole range from the library 📚

  • Click a song, Shift-click another, right-click and choose Load to > Project. They join the end of the mix in the same order, each one blended into the next, and the view shows the first of them.

The Project tab looks like the library 🖼️

  • Cover art, waveform, artist, year, key, genre, energy, duration, rating, comment and date added for every song in your mix.
  • Scroll sideways for more columns. The transition stays pinned on the right.

Also new ✨

  • GlideMix now tells you what changed the first time it starts after an update.
  • Single wave is the default track view on a fresh install.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.21
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.21 (Mac and Windows)

New: the Project tab, your mix as a playlist 🎚️

  • A Project tab next to Music library lists the songs of your mix in order: #, title, artist, BPM (with stretch %), key and the transition into the next song.
  • Drag a row to reorder your mix. Every song snaps in with its IN on the previous song's OUT, the lanes follow the new order, and the changed pairs get their transition again. One Undo puts everything back.
  • Pick each transition from the row's drop-down. The choice is saved with the project.
  • Click a row and the timeline zooms to that song: no more scrolling to the end of a long mix. After a drag it zooms to the song you moved.
  • A thin bar under each row shows how far the song has played; click it to jump there.

Songs snap into the mix every time 🧲

  • A song double-clicked in the library always joins the end of the mix, linked and with a transition, however far away it was.
  • Delete a song and the songs after it close the gap.
  • A song that isn't analysed yet is analysed straight away and joins the mix when it's ready.
  • No more silence between songs: a song's IN now sits where its music really starts, and its OUT stays on music that's still loud.
  • A smoother default blend: the new song fades in and is at full volume on its IN, the old one leaves after its OUT, and the bass changes hands right there.
  • Each row's drop-down also offers MixMeister's classic Beatmix transitions (8 to 64 bars). The smooth S-curve crossfade stays the default.

Volume lines on from the start 📈

  • Every song's volume line shows straight away, so you can shape a fade without looking for the automation button first. The button still hides it.

Smarter mix points 🎯

  • GlideMix skips a quiet first or last phrase when it places a song's IN and OUT, and short songs get shorter phrases so they still mix.

A huge library opens fast ⚡

  • With a big rekordbox-imported library, sorting or searching could freeze GlideMix for up to two minutes. It now takes a fraction of a second (tested on 38,000 songs).

Plugins 🔌

  • If a plugin crashes GlideMix while it loads, opens its window or plays, GlideMix turns it off the next time it starts and tells you which one. To try it again: Effect > Plugin manager, tick "Include plugins with errors", then Rescan.
  • VST3 plugins now keep knob changes made while stopped, and plugin names with accents show correctly.
  • Known issue: older AIR Music Technology plugins can still crash GlideMix. Please let us know which plugins misbehave for you.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.20
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.20 (Mac and Windows)

Songs with special characters drop onto the timeline again 💿

  • With an effect on the master track, songs whose file names have accents, emoji or special spaces (common in downloaded compilations) didn't land on the timeline. Nothing happened, and no message appeared. They drop normally again, however many tracks you have.

Smoother playback, much less CPU ⚡

  • During playback, every transition kept recalculating its knobs and faders on every frame, even with its window closed. Now only an open transition window follows the playhead. On a test mix, GlideMix's CPU use went from about 100% to about 36%.

Fixed: a crash when closing a master effect window 🎛️

  • Closing a master effect's window with its red button could close GlideMix. Fixed.

Known issue: AIR Music Technology plugins

  • AIR plugins (AIR Compressor and the rest of the AIR range) crash GlideMix when added. Please don't use them for now.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.19
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.19 (Mac and Windows)

Transition window: play the knobs like a mixer 🎛️

  • High, Mid, Low, Color and the VOL fader now change the sound while you turn them, not only after you let go.
  • Turn a knob while the mix plays and the move is recorded as you make it. Stopped, a turn sets one point at the playhead.
  • Each move is one undo step.
  • The knobs follow the playhead: move it and they show the transition's value at that spot.
  • VOL is a real fader now, with a cap you can grab.
  • The scroll wheel moves a knob in small steps (it used to jump to 0% or 100%).

Fixed: a crash on save after EQ moves

  • After some knob moves in a transition, saving could close GlideMix. Fixed, and a project already affected opens and saves normally again.

BEATMATCH pills stay on their transition 🔗

  • Zoom the tracks in, scroll, zoom back out: the pill stays on its transition instead of floating away.

The music keeps playing when you move the playhead ▶️

  • Drag the playhead somewhere else while the mix plays, even past the end of a selection, and the music carries on from where you dropped it.

One copy per drop

  • Dragging a song from the library onto the timeline sometimes left a second, pale copy behind. Now you get just the song.

DJ-style knobs and faders 🎚️

  • The track pan knob, the track volume, the zoom sliders and the library text size and row height sliders have a new DJ look: a silver fader cap on a dark slot, and a rubber knob with a value ring.
  • Every track keeps its pan knob and volume fader after you reopen a project (tracks at the smallest height used to lose them).

Single wave by default 🌊

  • New songs open as one waveform in half the height, so more of the mix fits on screen. Switch any track back with View > Track view or the track's right-click menu.

Reset keeps your licence

  • Preferences > Reset no longer turns a Standard or Pro licence back into the demo.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.18
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.18 (Mac and Windows)

Fixed: songs no longer land on the timeline in pieces 🎚️

  • Drag or double-click a song in and it stays one clip, every time. (v1.1.17 sometimes cut a song where it thought the beats moved off the grid, and could leave the second piece minutes away.)
  • Want to fix a song whose beats really do jump part-way (a demo stitched from loops, a mashup)? Right-click it and choose Split at grid jumps. It cuts just before each jump and puts every part back on the bar. Undo puts it back together.

Phrase colours for Lexicon songs on any computer 🌈

  • The INTRO / UP / CHORUS ribbon under each song now also shows for Lexicon songs on a computer without rekordbox (for example Windows). GlideMix works the phrases out itself in the background, a few seconds after the song lands.

One look for every track 👀

  • New View > Track view: show every song as Waveform, Spectrogram, Multi-view, Half-wave or Single wave in one go. Songs you add later follow the same look.
  • The same choice is in Preferences > Waveforms > Track view.

Same menus on the song and on the track name

  • Right-click a song or right-click the track name: both now have Color (Color by key, Clip color, Track color, Intensity, Reset colors) and Track visualization.
  • Half-wave and Single wave are no longer greyed out while Preferences is open.

Tidier stems download

  • The stems engine download now just counts its steps (1/4 … 4/4) instead of listing technical package names.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.17
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.17 (Mac and Windows)

New: songs that jump off their beat grid stay on the beat 🥁

  • Some songs don't sit on one steady grid: demos stitched from loops, edits, mashups. Part-way through, the beats move a few hundredths of a second, and from there the metronome and your other songs flam against the kicks.
  • GlideMix now hears this when you add a song with SYNC on (drag it in or double-click it): it splits the song just before the jump and slides the later part back onto the bar. You see the cut on the timeline.
  • Normal songs made on a steady grid are left exactly as they were.

Fixed

  • Double-clicking a song into an empty project, then Undo and Redo, no longer brings the song back off the bar.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.16
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.16 (Mac and Windows)

New: loops and repeats the Logic / Ableton way 🔁

  • Draw a loop in the ruler: drag across the top half of the time ruler and that section loops right away. Drag the loop's edges to resize it, drag its middle to move it, press L to turn looping on or off.
  • Loop a selection: drag over part of a track to select it, right-click and choose Loop (or press Shift+L). Split is in the same menu.
  • Repeat with Cmd+D (Ctrl+D on Windows): the selected section is copied right after itself on the same track, and the selection moves onto the copy, so pressing again keeps repeating it. With SYNC on the selection snaps to whole bars first, so the repeats stay on the beat. A selected clip repeats right after itself too.
  • The new keys are in Help → Keyboard shortcuts.

Fixed

  • "Connection to project file is null" when pressing Play after starting a new project.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.15
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.15 (Mac and Windows)

New: the transition as a DJ mixer 🎛️

  • Mix a transition on a 2-channel mixer laid out like a Pioneer DJM: CH 1 is the song going out, CH 2 the song coming in.
  • Each channel: HI / MID / LOW with KILL, a COLOR filter knob (left low-pass, right high-pass) and a channel fader. Below them the crossfader with Smooth / Constant / Cut curves.
  • BEAT FX: pick Echo, Reverb, Roll, Brake, Tape stop, Riser or Sweep, set LEVEL/DEPTH and hit the big ON/OFF.
  • REC: switch it on, press play and ride the knobs and faders — your moves are written into the transition as automation. Stopped, a move sets one point at the playhead.
  • Turn it on in Preferences → Transitions → The transition pill opens: The DJ mixer, then click the cog on a BEATMATCH / CROSSFADE pill. The classic transition window is still there.
  • Controls shown dim (TRIM, meters, Dub Echo / Sweep / Noise, FX frequency, EQ curve, some effects) are coming in later updates.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.14
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.14 (Mac and Windows)

Smooth S-curves 〰️

  • Volume and FX automation now ease in and out like a DJ riding a fader, the same S-curves as the tempo line. Right-click a point → Line: straight or Line: S-curve.
  • Crossfades are drawn as one smooth line per song instead of a row of dots.
  • No more stray automation points left on screen after a transition is changed or switched off.

Transitions

  • Right-click the BEATMATCH / CROSSFADE pill to switch a transition off: its fades, EQ and effects are removed and the pill turns grey. Right-click again to bring it back.
  • Add effect in the transition panel: each effect gets its own row with an on/off button, an amount knob and a remove button, like a track's effect list. Effects now act inside the transition only, not over the rest of the song.
  • Fixed on Windows: choosing an effect in the transition panel did nothing.

Mixing

  • Master effects with look-ahead (limiters): the playhead, click and exports now line up with the music.
  • Track height slider resizes all tracks in one smooth step.
  • A quick double right-click on a song in the library no longer adds it to the mix.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.13
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.13 (Mac and Windows)

Energy you can read at a glance ⚡

  • The ENERGY view is drawn like a row of level meters: green when the mix is calm, yellow as it builds, red at the peak. Solid, vivid colours instead of the faded ones.
  • The tempo line is now the same bright yellow as volume automation.
  • The library's Energy column shows LED blocks (one per point) and the number, like Lexicon.

Library

  • Keys as coloured badges in the key wheel's colours (Preferences → Music library → Show keys as coloured badges).
  • Zoom sliders above the list for text size and row height, like rekordbox's Font Size and Line Space.
  • Lexicon keys in other notations (Open Key "8M", traditional "Am") now get their colours, badges and harmonic filters.

Analysis

  • Analysis uses: Performance / Normal / Power saving (Preferences → Music library), like rekordbox.
  • The status line shows a steady "Analysing 7 of 20" with a progress bar and time left; no more flicker between songs.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.12
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.12 (Mac and Windows)

Much faster analysis ⚡

  • Mac: the beat grid is worked out on the graphics chip (Core ML), with the full, most accurate beat model. On our test Mac, 288 songs took 4 min 42 s (rekordbox 7 on the same songs: about 20 minutes). A new song is ready in about a second.
  • Windows: each song's beat analysis now uses all free processor cores, so a single new song is several times faster.
  • Beat grids are a little closer to rekordbox's (tested on 200 songs).

Status line at the bottom of the window, like Ableton and Logic 💬

  • Shows what GlideMix is doing: scanning your folders, "Analysing 7 of 20 · Artist – Title · about 1 minute left" with a progress bar and Stop, loading the rekordbox XML, working out energy, installing the stems engine. Then a short message when it's done.
  • Hover over any button and the status line explains what it does.
  • When a new version is out: "GlideMix 1.x is out · Click to update".

Library

  • The Rating column shows five stars, empty ones outlined, like rekordbox. Click a star to rate; click it again to clear.

Also

  • Help → GlideMix Manual: the full manual on glidemix.com.
  • About: Mixxx is thanked in one line instead of 400 names.
  • "1 song" / "2 songs" instead of "song(s)".

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.11
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.11 (Mac and Windows)

Energy for every song on the timeline ⚡

  • Songs without an energy rating (for example songs imported from rekordbox, which doesn't rate energy) get one automatically a few seconds after you put them on the timeline. The rating shows in the library's Energy column too. Their beat grid and key stay as they are.
  • Songs from Lexicon now show how their energy rises and falls (intro, breakdowns, drops), instead of one flat block.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.10
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.10 (Mac and Windows)

Fix

  • Import from Rekordbox XML… now opens the file chooser in your Documents folder (or the folder of the XML you used last). On Windows it used to open in a system folder.

Also see v1.1.9: rekordbox XML opens like Lexicon, with a progress bar while it loads.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.9
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.9 (Mac and Windows)

rekordbox XML import, like Lexicon 🎛️

  • Import from Rekordbox XML… (File menu, or right-click Rekordbox XML in the sidebar) now opens your rekordbox library in place, just like Lexicon: the song count shows next to Rekordbox XML, and its playlists and folders open beneath it.
  • A big XML shows "Loading 42%" with a progress bar while it is read, instead of nothing.
  • Before you have picked a file, clicking Rekordbox XML asks you for it.
  • A file that isn't a rekordbox XML gets a clear message.
  • The old way, copying every rekordbox song into your Music Collection, is still there as Copy Rekordbox XML into Music Collection….

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.8
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.8 (Mac and Windows)

Find Duplicates 🔁

  • New Duplicates under Music Collection: songs that are in your collection more than once (same artist and title, same length), side by side with the best copy first (WAV/AIFF/FLAC before MP3, then the higher bitrate).
  • Select extra copies selects every copy except the best one, ready for Remove from Library or Delete from Disk.

Smart Playlist generator ⚙️

  • Right-click Smart Playlists → Generate Smart Playlists: one playlist per genre, per key or per energy level, from your collection, Lexicon, rekordbox or all of them, in one go.
  • Delete Generated Smart Playlists removes them all again.

Small comforts

  • The sidebar marks every playlist and smart playlist that contains the selected song.
  • Each list remembers its sort, scroll position and selected song while GlideMix runs.
  • The Energy column reads "Energy 7".

Fixes and more

  • A folder added in Preferences → Music library is scanned and analysed right away (before, its songs came in at the next start).
  • A newly analysed song's cue markers now show at once (they needed a restart).
  • Energy is closer to Lexicon's ratings for high-energy songs.
  • New glidemix.com website: Help → Help and FAQ and Help → GlideMix website.
  • The licence window shows the Beta price: €49 (normal price €89).

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.7
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.7 (Mac and Windows)

Energy ⚡

  • New Energy column right after BPM: every song rated Energy 1–10, like Mixed In Key and Lexicon. Sort by it, and use it in Smart Playlists ("Energy 7–9 and BPM 124–128").
  • Lexicon songs show Lexicon's own energy. Your Music Collection songs get theirs from GlideMix's analysis, tuned to agree with Lexicon's ratings (songs analysed before this version: press Analyze once).
  • ENERGY button next to TEMPO: the energy of the whole mix drawn behind the tempo line, blue (calm) to red (peak). See how your set builds, where it drops, and where a breakdown or a long fade lets it sag.

Watch folders 📂

  • The music folders in Preferences → Music library are now watched while GlideMix runs: copy or download a song into one and it appears in your Music Collection a few seconds later.
  • New songs are analysed automatically (BPM, key, beat grid, phrases, energy). Both can be switched off in Preferences.

Cue points

  • The waveforms in the library now show each song's cue points, like rekordbox: hot cues A, B, C… in their colours and memory cues along the bottom.
  • Export to rekordbox XML gives songs without cue points hot cues where their phrases start (Intro, Up, Chorus, Down, Outro), on the beat grid, plus memory cues, so they arrive on CDJs ready to play.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.6
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.6 (Mac and Windows)

Smart Playlists ⚙️

  • New Smart Playlists in the library sidebar: playlists that fill themselves from rules, like rekordbox's Intelligent Playlists and Lexicon's Smartlists.
  • Pick from your Music Collection, Lexicon, rekordbox XML or all of them. Match all or any rules, with "or…" alternatives.
  • Rules for genre, artist, title, comment, BPM, key, rating, color, year, length, date added, last played, play count, playlist and more.
  • DJ extras: Key "mixes with" (harmonic) and BPM "within ±%" (half and double tempo count too).
  • "Only the 50 newest", a live count while you edit, and Duplicate as Playlist.

Export to Folder

  • Right-click any playlist (your own, smart, Lexicon or rekordbox) → Export to Folder…: the songs copied in order, plus a track list (.txt) and an .m3u8 for players and USB sticks.

Export to rekordbox XML

  • Right-click Music Collection → Export to rekordbox XML…: tracks with tags, stars, colors and beat grids (cue points for Lexicon songs), your playlist folders and smart playlists, ready to import into rekordbox or Lexicon. Their own databases are never touched.

Also

  • Home → Learn has a link to the new r/GlideMix community on Reddit.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.5
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.5 (Mac and Windows)

Tracklist with every export

  • Every exported mix now gets its tracklist beside it: a `.txt` with timestamps and Artist - Title, ready to paste into Mixcloud or your show notes, plus a `.cue` sheet. Times match the file, tempo changes included.

A friendlier demo

  • The demo no longer goes silent. Instead, every 2 minutes a voice says "Glide Mix demo" over the music, so you hear every transition in full.
  • Demo exports are MP3 at 96 kbps, up to 20 minutes. The export window shows it.
  • A licence (€49, one-time) removes all of it.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.4
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.4 (Mac and Windows)

Learn, right on Home

  • Home has a new Learn page: getting started, what's new, every keyboard shortcut, the Discord community, support by email, and your licence. All one click away.

Simpler automation recording

  • The LATCH button is gone. ARM works as always: while the mix plays, turn any knob of any plugin and the move is written into its line; let go and the line plays on as it was.

Meters like a DJ mixer

  • New installs start with gradient meters (green, yellow, red). Change the style any time in the meter settings.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.3
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.3 (Mac and Windows)

How loud is your mix?

  • After every export GlideMix tells you the loudness (LUFS), the true peak and the peak, and what Spotify, YouTube and Apple Music will do with it (they play music at about -14 LUFS).

Never clips, not even as an MP3

  • The master limiter now watches the true peak, between the samples too, and looks 1.5 ms ahead so it glides down instead of jumping. Mixes stay under -1 dBTP, so an MP3 or AAC made from them doesn't distort. It works on everything: speakers, headphones (CUE), export and broadcast, after the ROOM and CUE faders.

Smoother tempo changes

  • When two songs at different tempos overlap, the tempo now glides in an S-curve: it leaves the old tempo gently and settles gently into the new one, like a hand on the pitch fader. Right-click a point on the tempo line: Glide: straight or Glide: S-curve.

Fade shapes

  • Preferences → Transitions: crossfades and fades get a Shape: equal power (as before), linear, S-curve, early or late.

Touch or Latch

  • New LATCH button next to ARM. Off (Touch): when you let go of a knob, the line goes back to what it was. On: your last value keeps being written until you stop playback.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.2
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.2 (Mac and Windows)

One licence, everything included

  • GlideMix – €49 unlocks everything, stems included. One-time payment, 3 computers, all 1.x updates: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_4uiOdwpksKcRSApaB9BWrDJ0Scu1AFet9FgtC4ZQyQJ
  • Help → Licence… shows the one Buy button; keys bought earlier keep working.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.1
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.1 (Mac and Windows)

Better sound on smaller PCs

  • On computers with 2 cores (4 threads), GlideMix used a cheap sample-rate converter to avoid crackles. It dulled the highs: hi-hats and cymbals came out softer and gritty, in playback and in exports. It now uses a proper high-quality converter (windowed sinc), clean far below hearing, and still light enough for small PCs.
  • Faster computers, and every Mac with more than 4 threads, were not affected.

item.title: GlideMix 1.1.0
item.description:
GlideMix Beta v1.1.0 (Mac and Windows)

GlideMix is in Beta

  • Every download starts as the free demo: everything works, but every 2 minutes the sound goes quiet for a few seconds, exported mixes get a short noise in those gaps, and an export stops after 20 minutes. The window title says *GlideMix Demo*.
  • A licence removes the limits for good. One-time payment, 3 computers, all 1.x updates:
  • Help → Licence…: buy, enter your key (from *Access purchase* in the order email), or Deactivate this computer to move the licence to another one. Activation needs the internet once; after that GlideMix works offline.

Source code

  • The complete source code of this version is attached (`GlideMix-1.1.0-source.tar.xz`, GNU GPL). Building it yourself can be challenging; we don't provide help for it.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.9
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.9 Early Preview (Mac and Windows)

Edit Tags

  • Right-click a song, or several selected songs, → Edit Tags…: Title, Artist, Album, Album Artist, Genre, Year, Track #, Composer, Grouping, Comment.
  • With several songs, a field they don't share shows Mixed and stays as it is unless you type in it.
  • Saved into the music files too (you can switch this off), so rekordbox and Lexicon see the change after re-reading the tags (rekordbox: right-click → Reload Tag; Lexicon: sync from file tags). Their own databases are never changed by GlideMix.
  • Edits on Lexicon and rekordbox songs show in GlideMix right away.

Also

  • About → credits: a Works with section for rekordbox and Lexicon.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.8
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.8 Early Preview (Mac and Windows)

Library: ratings and colors

  • Stars and colors you set show up at once (before, only after switching views).
  • Rate and color Lexicon and rekordbox songs too. GlideMix keeps these in its own library; Lexicon's and rekordbox's databases stay untouched.
  • Select Color offers rekordbox's 8 track colors (Pink, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Aqua, Blue, Purple), each with its color circle. The old list was too long for the menu to open.

Also new

  • A development history on the GitHub page: every change since the first build.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.7
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.7 Early Preview (Mac and Windows)

Fix

  • GlideMix could crash when you pressed Perform or Stop (the red Perform playhead), most often on Windows. Fixed.

Also in this version (from v1.0.6, now on Windows too)

  • Exported mixes no longer clip: export goes through the same engine as playback, with its limiter, the tempo line and all plugin automation.
  • Automation lanes: in Automation mode, Show in own lane puts a plugin's line in a lane of its own under the track. Optional; working on the clip itself stays the default.
  • Dragging songs from the library quickly no longer leaves a song stuck to the mouse.
  • GlideMix's own folder (new projects, exports) is now Music → Glidemix instead of Documents.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.6
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.6 Early Preview (Mac; the Windows installer follows)

Exports sound like playback

  • Exported mixes no longer clip: export now goes through the same engine as playback, with its limiter, the tempo line and all plugin automation. A 20-minute test mix: 0 clipped samples, peak −1 dBFS (before: over 1% of samples clipped).

Automation lanes

  • New, optional: in Automation mode, Show in own lane puts a plugin's line in a lane of its own under the track, editable directly, with its name and a close button in the track header. Lanes are saved with the project. Working on the clip itself stays the default and takes no extra space.

Fixes

  • Dragging songs from the library quickly no longer leaves a song stuck to the mouse.
  • GlideMix's own folder (new projects, exports) is now Music → Glidemix instead of Documents, and rekordbox.xml is read only once you pick it. GlideMix itself no longer asks for your Documents folder. (Some plugins keep their presets in Documents; macOS may still ask once when GlideMix first checks them, as it does for other music apps.)

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.5
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.5 Early Preview

More songs on screen

  • New: Single wave. In a track's ⋯ menu → Track visualization → Single wave, a stereo track is drawn as one waveform and its lane takes about half the height, so more of the mix fits on screen. Choose it again to get both channels and the full height back. It's saved with the project. The beat grid editor is unchanged.

Mac: this is the first update you can install from inside GlideMix: Help → Check for update → Install Update, then Install and Relaunch.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.4
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.4 Early Preview

Updates

  • Mac: updates now install themselves. Help → Check for update shows what's new; Install Update downloads it, and Install and Relaunch puts it in place and reopens GlideMix. No more dragging a DMG or clicking Open Anyway. (This update itself still comes the old way, one last time.)
  • Mac updater apps (Updatest, Latest, MacUpdater) can now see GlideMix and its new versions.

Fixes

  • Mac: no more crash when adding the 4th song or later to a mix.

Performing and stems

  • The performance's Stop button sits right next to PERFORM.
  • Stem lanes are named by the stem first: Drums — <song>, Bass — <song>, Vocals — <song>, Other — <song>.

Behind the scenes

  • Windows: GlideMix writes down every audio dropout during a performance, with the timings, to find the cause of crackles in transitions.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.3
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.3 Early Preview

Keyboard shortcuts

  • New: Help → Keyboard shortcuts lists every shortcut, A to Z, with what it does and a search box.
  • Edit shortcuts… opens the shortcut editor (Preferences → Shortcuts): change any key, clear it, import or export a whole set. Picking a key that is already in use tells you which action has it before anything changes.

Building a mix with many songs

  • Add as many songs as you like: dragging a song under the last lane works every time, and the last lane always keeps room below it for the next one.
  • No more blink after a drop: the lanes no longer rebuild, so adding the 10th song is as quick as the 2nd.
  • The zoom stays where you set it, as in Ableton or Logic. The view only scrolls when the new song lands off screen. Cmd+F / Ctrl+F fits the whole mix.
  • Double-click a song in the library to add it at the end of the mix, linked to the last song.
  • Windows: the music library docks full width under the timeline, as on the Mac.

Automation

  • Plugin knobs draw and play as smooth ramps. Only switches and short choice lists (like an effect selector) step.

Look

  • Mac: no empty band above the toolbar on MacBooks with a notch; full screen no longer hides the top row.
  • Windows: the GlideMix icon on every window and plugin window, and in the installer.
  • The turntable artwork moved from the Home page to the start-up screen.
  • Folder pickers open in your Music folder.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.2
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.2 Early Preview

Faster analysis

  • Tracks you already analysed in rekordbox or Lexicon take their beat grid from there (and Lexicon's key): a few seconds per batch instead of seconds per track.
  • Other tracks use a faster beat detector by default, about 1.7× quicker. For the most exact grids, turn on Preferences → Music library → Accurate beat analysis.
  • The progress bar no longer sits at 95% while a track is being analysed.

Building a mix

  • Dragging songs from the library one after another works every time (every other song used to get lost on the Mac).
  • After a drop the view zooms and scrolls to the new song, together with the song before it and the one after it.
  • New lanes scroll into view instead of appearing below the visible area.

Updates

  • Windows: updates install by themselves and GlideMix reopens.
  • The update window names the version it found.

item.title: GlideMix 1.0.1
item.description:
GlideMix Alpha v1.0.1 Early Preview — the first build that updates itself.

New

  • GlideMix now checks for new versions when it starts and shows what changed. You can also check any time with Help → Check for updates…
  • Better phrase detection (Intro, Chorus, Down, Outro…), trained on 35,000 tracks. Re-analyse tracks to get the new phrases.
  • Windows: library preview works, for every format.
  • Windows: Preferences are also in File and in a new Settings menu.

Mixing

  • A track dropped near another track's OUT snaps its IN onto it, at any zoom.
  • Dragging a song moves only that song: no more songs jumping to the end of the mix, duplicated or moved by accident.
  • A song dropped on a taken lane gets a new lane right there, named after the song; empty lanes are removed.
  • New lanes have the same height as the others.
  • A song far from the mix tempo (more than 8%) plays at its own tempo and the tempo line glides to it, with points you can drag.

Sound and speed

  • Playback uses far less CPU: no more crackles on small PCs (an old bug re-read the audio 200 times a second).
  • A safety limiter stops loud overlaps from clipping.
  • Windows: all audio formats are read (AAC, ALAC, AIFF, FLAC, OGG, Opus, WAV, WMA), also with special characters in file names.

Fixes

  • The faint line across empty lanes is gone, so the grid looks even.
  • Zooming out stops at the length of the mix.
